title: Orbit setup texts
description: Every string `orbit setup` writes into an assistant's files: the managed instruction block, the hook nudges, and the values filling {{name}} placeholders in assistant templates. Read by crates/orbit-cli/src/commands/setup/spec.rs.

instructions.description: Markdown spliced into each assistant's instruction file between the orbit:setup markers.

nudge_search.description: Context the hook guard returns for a search whose term or target it cannot name.

nudge_usage.description: Context the hook guard returns for a text search over a tree for an identifier; {{term}} is the identifier.

nudge_in_file.description: Context the hook guard returns for a text search inside one source file; {{term}} is the identifier and {{path}} the shell-quoted file.

nudge_read.description: Context the hook guard returns for a source-file read.

template_vars.description: Values substituted for {{name}} placeholders in the templates assistants declare. They reach a shell echo, so they must not contain quotes, backticks, or $(.
